provenance.sampler: pauliprop.propagate_realised on redraw_gate1b.dial_program(model=unital, zz_layer_on=True) and redraw_gate1b.probe_masks; truncation probes 16 batches x 125,000 paths (2e6), gradient probes 8 x 125,000 (1e6); seeds 0 .. batches - 1, the same for every channel
provenance.errors: value: s.e. over batch means; relative change to nominal: paired over batches (delta method on the ratio of batch means); ratios across probes: the two probes independent

channel_parameters.kept_branch: B0 = (d(1-k), d(1-k), 1-gz, gz), d = exp(-400 ns / T2); k = kT + kN on the reset dial, kT on the dephasing dial

vertices.MIX: kT 0.005, kN 0.10, gz 0.016, e1 eps_A, r +sqrt(eps_A)
vertices.INT: kN 0.05, gz 0.008, e1 = e0 = eps_A / 2, r half its bound

calibration_bounds.quantiles: min, 5 %, median, 95 %, max over the 48 rung qubits

zz.note: worst loss = 1 - prod_e cos(2 pi J_e 400 ns) over the in-patch couplers of a qubit: every neighbour excited for the whole reset window; an upper bound on the part of the idle ZZ the model leaves out when a neighbour is reset

h7.point: reset dial p = 0.5, L = 8, n60 rung (n = 48, edge 84_85), probe trunc_full_p0.5_L8, seed 23291001, K = 256, l = 2

additivity.note: the (e1, r) domain is not a box: LO2 lies below LO1 at every level

a.point: reset dial p = 0.25, L = 8, n60 rung, probe trunc_full_p0.25_L8, seed 23891001

b.point: dephasing dial p = 0.5, L = 8, n60 rung, probe trunc_full_dephase_p0.5_L8, seed 23891001

margin.definition: RMS_dephase(2) - RMS_reset(2), both comparators at the same kept-branch parameters; the reset side is H7 comparator

h5_h6.note: rows on the realised masks of the day-3 gradient probes; var_cost = cost_off - S^2(c0)/K as realised_dial_row; LO1/LO2/HI are the H7 vertices and are not the extremes of these rows: the upper extreme is gz alone, the lower e1 = e0 = eps_A (sum of the two one-parameter changes, not drawn as one channel)

bootstrap.note: rates as [value, binomial s.e.]; displacement axis = generated truth (mean sample truth), which sits 1.4 % (kurtosis 4) and 2.1 % (kurtosis 9) below the stated one at 0; rates at a vertex or at a round displacement are linear interpolations between grid scenarios

provisional: every band is drawn on the 10:16Z placement of the list on main; the placement that runs will differ and the realised-mask values move with the masks (second placement: band -7.6 % / +3.4 % against -8.9 % / +6.2 %)
